title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) Zero Balance Bank Account
benefits: Zero minimum balance requirement, free RuPay debit card, ₹2,00,000 accidental insurance cover, and overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 after satisfactory account operation.
eligibility: Any Indian resident aged 10+ years without an existing bank account.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Mobile Number, Passport photo (or Voter ID/NREGA card if Aadhaar not available).
how_to_apply: Visit any public/private commercial bank branch, regional rural bank (RRB), or Bank Mitra (CSP kiosk).

title: Safe UPI Payments, PIN Rules & Fraud Prevention
target_audience: Users of Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, and other UPI apps.
benefits: Essential security guidelines: UPI PIN is ONLY needed for SENDING money, NEVER for receiving money. QR codes scanned for receiving payments do not require entering PIN.
eligibility: All bank account holders using mobile UPI payments.
how_to_apply: Never share UPI PIN, OTP, or CVV with anyone. Do not click unknown links claiming 'Cashback won' or 'KYC expire'. In case of fraud, report within 24 hours to 1930.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) Collateral-Free Loans
target_audience: Small business owners, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, artisans, and service providers.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans in 3 categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh / ₹20 Lakh) with affordable interest.
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises engaged in income-generating activities.
documents_needed: Identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Address proof, Business registration/license, Quotation for machinery/items.
how_to_apply: Apply through any commercial bank, MFI, NBFC, or online at udyamimitra.in.

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) - ₹20/Year Accident Insurance
target_audience: Savings bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 cover for accidental death or permanent total disability, and ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability for an annual premium of just ₹20 auto-debited once a year.
eligibility: Individual bank account holders aged 18-70 years with active Aadhaar link.
documents_needed: Bank account number, Aadhaar card, Consent form for auto-debit.
how_to_apply: Submit auto-debit consent form at your bank branch, via netbanking/mobile banking, or through SMS.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) - Life Insurance
target_audience: Savings bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 life insurance coverage for death due to any cause for an annual premium of ₹436 per year auto-debited from bank account.
eligibility: All bank account holders aged 18-50 years with auto-debit consent.
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook, Nominee details.
how_to_apply: Enroll at your bank branch or through mobile banking before 31st May each year for coverage from June 1st to May 31st.

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) Guaranteed Monthly Old-Age Pension
target_audience: Unorganized sector workers and citizens aged 18 to 40 years.
benefits: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 starting from age 60. Same pension continues to spouse after subscriber's demise.
eligibility: All Indian citizens aged 18-40 years with a savings bank account (non-income tax payers).
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Savings Bank Account, Nominee Details.
how_to_apply: Enroll at your bank branch or through netbanking. Monthly contribution starts as low as ₹42/month depending on age.

title: AePS (Aadhaar Enabled Payment System) & Micro-ATM
target_audience: Rural citizens wanting cash withdrawal and deposit without visiting far bank branches.
benefits: Cash withdrawal, cash deposit, balance enquiry, and mini-statement using only your Aadhaar number and fingerprint biometric at any CSC or local Bank Mitra.
eligibility: Any person whose bank account is linked to Aadhaar.
how_to_apply: Visit any authorized Bank Correspondent (BC), CSC kiosk, or India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) postman.

title: Protection Against Fake Police/CBI 'Digital Arrest' & KYC Scams
target_audience: All citizens using smartphones and receiving suspicious video calls or SMS.
benefits: Crucial awareness: No government agency (Police, CBI, ED, RBI, Customs) conducts 'Digital Arrest' over WhatsApp/Skype or asks to transfer money for 'verification'.
documents_needed: Screenshot of caller number, transaction reference ID (UTR).
how_to_apply: If you receive a threatening video call or fake parcel call, immediately disconnect and report to cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930 without panic.
helpline: 1930 (National Cyber Crime Helpline) / 14440 (RBI Sachet Fraud Alert)

title: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit for Urban & Peri-Urban Street Vendors
target_audience: Street vendors, hawkers, cart pullers, and roadside food stall owners.
benefits: Initial working capital loan of ₹10,000 without collateral. On timely repayment, enhanced loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.
eligibility: Street vendors holding Certificate of Vending / ID Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
documents_needed: Aadhaar Card, Vending ID / Survey Reference Number, Bank Account.
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through Urban Local Body (Nagar Nigam) / CSC.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY) High-Interest Savings for Girl Child
target_audience: Parents of girl children aged up to 10 years.
benefits: Highest sovereign guaranteed interest rate (approx. 8.2% p.a.), tax exemption under Section 80C, and maturity corpus for higher education and marriage after age 18/21.
eligibility: Girl child residing in India up to age 10. Maximum 2 accounts per family.
documents_needed: Girl child birth certificate, Parent's KYC (Aadhaar & PAN), Address proof.
how_to_apply: Open account at any Post Office branch or designated commercial bank with minimum ₹250 deposit.
